name: Equilateral Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1988, Equilateral Enterprises  Ltd deals in diamonds and other precious & 
 semi-precious stones[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
EEL operates in the diamond and jewelry industry, engaging in activities such as acquisition, sale, cutting, polishing, manufacturing, and processing of diamonds, pearls, gems, and precious metals. The company is also involved in import, export, trade, brokerage, agency services, distribution, franchising, and collaborations. Its product portfolio includes ornaments featuring diamonds, gold, silver, and other precious and semi-precious stones.

cons: Stock is trading at 2.74 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 0.67% over last 3 years.
